title: T cell antigen discovery using signaling and antigen presenting bifunctional receptors \(SABRs)
protocol: Generate back-translated nucleotide sequences using the IDT Codon Optimization Tool.
Select "Amino Acids" as input sequence type, "gBlocks Gene Fragments" as product type, and "Homo sapiens (human)" as organism.
Enter a tab-delimited list of peptides on the "Bulk Entry" page.
Append "CAGGAGGGCTCGGCA" to the back-translated epitope sequences.
Append "<epitope sequence>" to the sequence from step 4.
Append "GGATGCGGAGGGTCC" to the sequence from step 5.
Append random nucleotides to the end of each epitope oligo for normalization.
Submit the first 100 bp of each nucleotide sequence with appended random nucleotides for synthesis.
Digest backbone plasmid with restriction enzyme specific to overhangs.
Prepare 1200 μl of digestion buffer (120 μl of 10X NEB 3.1 Buffer, 48 μl of NEB BsmBI Enzyme, 72 μl of Addgene backbone plasmid at 1 ug/ul, 960 μl of Nuclease-free water).
Aliquot 100 μl across 12 PCR strips.
Incubate for 6 hours at 55°C.
Heat inactivate enzyme at 80°C for 20 minutes.
Pool all digestion reactions in a 1.5 mL eppendorf tube.
Purify with NucleoSpin Gel and PCR purification kit, using one column per 240 μl of digested plasmid (5 columns total).
Elute in 20 μl Elution Buffer per column.
Pool elutions in a 1.5 mL eppendorf tube.
Prepare 600 μl of second digestion buffer (60 μl of 10X NEB 3.1 Buffer, 24 μl of NEB BsmBI Enzyme, 100 μl of digested Addgene backbone from Step 2, 416 μl of Nuclease-free water).
Aliquot 100 μl across 6 PCR strips.
Incubate for 6 hours at 55°C.
Heat inactivate enzyme at 80°C for 20 minutes.
Pour a 0.9% agarose gel by mixing 1.08 g agarose and 120 mL TAE buffer, heating until fully dissolved above 95°C, cooling to 60°C, adding 10 μl gel green, and casting in a gel tray with wide combs.
Pool all second digest reactions in a 1.5 mL eppendorf tube (total volume of 600 μl).
Add 120 μl 6X Purple Loading Dye to the pooled digest mixture.
Load 65 μl per well on the gel for 11 total wells.
Load 10 μl 2-log Ladder in a remaining empty well.
Run the gel at 120 V for 1 hour or until dye front runs 75% of the gel length.
Briefly image the gel in a gel imager at 365 nm UV wavelength.
Cut out the larger band corresponding to the digested plasmid with a razor.
Place each excised band into a separate 2 mL eppendorf tube.
Follow instructions for NucleoSpin Gel and PCR purification kit, using one column per 4 wells of excised plasmid (3 columns in total).
Elute the purified plasmids in 20 μl Elution Buffer per column.
Pool elutions in a 1.5 mL eppendorf tube.
Dilute or resuspend single-stranded oligo pool to 10 ng/ul with Elution Buffer.

Prepare 600 ul library amplification mix \(300 ul of 2X KOD master mix, 24 ul of 10 uM Oligo-Amplify-Fwd, 24 ul of 10 uM Oligo-Amplify-Rev, 2.4 ul of 10 ng/ul single-stranded oligo pool, and 250 ul of Nuclease-free water).
Aliquot mix to 24 wells of a PCR plate or strips.
Amplify according to the program: Initial Denaturation at 95°C for 2 minutes.
Cycle through 6 cycles of 95°C for 20 seconds \(denature), 61°C for 10 seconds \(anneal), and 70°C for 15 seconds \(extension).
Perform a final extension at 70°C for 1 minute.
Store amplified library at 4°C for up to a month or at -20°C indefinitely.
Pool all amplification reactions in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
PCR purify with NucleoSpin Gel and PCR purification kit using one column.
Elute the purified product in 17 μl Elution Buffer.
Dilute linearized vector to 100 ng/ul.
Dilute double-stranded oligo pool to 12.5 ng/ul.
Prepare 10 ul of ligation mix containing 2 ul of 5X In-Fusion mix, 2 ul of linearized vector at 100 ng/ul, 2 ul of double-stranded oligo pool at 12.5 ng/ul, and 4 ul of Nuclease-free water.
Prepare 10 ul of no-insert ligation mix containing 2 ul of linearized vector and 8 ul of Nuclease-free water.
Incubate the ligation mixes at 50°C for 15 minutes.
Store the mixes at 4°C for up to one month or at -20°C indefinitely.
Dilute both ligation mix and no-insert mix to 24 μl with Nuclease-free water.
Transform 2 μl of ligation mix per tube using NEB 5-alpha high efficiency competent cells in 12 tubes (50 μl each).
Pool cells diluted in SOC after recovery.
Perform four serial dilutions on an aliquot of pooled cells and plate equal volumes of each dilution on LB + Carbenicillin plates to calculate transformation efficiency.
Inoculate 1.5 L of LB + Carbenicillin liquid media with the remainder of the cell mixture, split across 3 maxi prep flasks.
Incubate plates at 37°C for 12 hours or longer.
Incubate liquid media in a shaking incubator at 37°C for 12 hours or longer.
Calculate library coverage from the amount of transformed cells pre-dilution, total amount of pooled cell mixture, and number of unique oligos in the library.
Maxi prep the 1.5 L of liquid media across three maxi columns.
Pool maxi preps in a 2 mL eppendorf tube.
Store plasmids at 4°C for up to one month or at -20°C indefinitely.
Prepare D10 media (55 mL of FBS and 5.5 mL Penicillin Streptomycin added to a 500 mL bottle of DMEM), warm D10 to room temperature.
Coat a 10 cm Tissue-culture treated dish with poly-L-Lysine, add 10 ml of poly-L-Lysine to the plate and swirl to cover the entire surface, aspirate remaining poly-L-Lysine.
Aspirate supernatant from a 15 cm plate of HEK-293T cells.
Add 6 ml of Trypsin and ensure it covers the entire surface.
Incubate plate at 37°C for 2-3 min until cells detach from the surface.
Add 15 ml of D10 to wash all cells off using a 10-ml serological pipet.
Form a single cell suspension by repeatedly pipetting up and down the cells.
Count the cells using a hemocytometer and adjust concentration to 0.5e6 cells/ml with D10.
Add 10 ml of cell suspension to the poly-L-Lysine coated plate, shake forward-backward and side-by-side for even distribution.
Incubate the plate overnight in a CO2 incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2, and 95% relative humidity.
Warm OPTI-MEM and D10 to room temperature.
Mix 1 ml of OPTI-MEM with 100 μl of TransIT-293 per 10 cm plate.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Prepare a mixture of lentiviral vector shuttle and packaging plasmids using 5 ug of the lentiviral shuttle plasmid, 5 ug of the pCMV-RD8.9 plasmid, and 1 ug of the pMDG-VSVG plasmid.
Combine both mixtures and mix well by pipetting up and down gently.
Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Aspirate the medium from the plated HEK-293T cells from Day 1.
Replace the medium with 10 ml of fresh D10.
Add the mixture dropwise to the plated HEK-293T cells gently without disturbing the cell monolayer.
Incubate the plate for 3 days in a CO2 incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2, and 95% relative humidity.
Remove the plate from the incubator.
Harvest the medium with a 10 ml serological pipet without disturbing the cell monolayer.
Filter the medium through a 0.45 micron PVDF filter.
Aliquot the filtered vector in 1.5ml microcentrifuge tubes.
Store the aliquoted vector at -80°C until further use.
Thaw the viral vector from Step 35 at room temperature or 37°C.
Mix the thawed viral vector by vortexing briefly.
Distribute 500 μl of cell suspension from Step 37 in each well of a 12-well tissue-culture treated plate.
Add 500 μl of thawed viral vector to each well and mix by pipetting up and down.
Incubate the plate for 3 days in a CO2 incubator at 37°C, with 5% CO2 and 95% relative humidity.
If using NFAT-GFP-Jurkat cells, add 1 ml of R10+ 2 mg/ml G-418 to each well at 48 hours post-transduction.
Prepare R10 media by adding 55 mL of FBS and 5.5 mL Penicillin Streptomycin to a 500 mL bottle of RPMI, then warm the R10 to room temperature.
Count transduced target Jurkat cells from Step 43 and transduced effector NFAT-GFP cells on FACS or hemocytometer.
Pool 1.5e6 effector cells and 1.5e6 target cells per replicate in a 50 mL conical tube for each pair of targets and effectors, bringing all tubes to equal volume with R10.
Centrifuge the tubes at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant from the tubes.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 6 mL R10 per replicate.
Distribute the resuspended cell mixture across wells of a 6-well plate, aliquoting 6 mL of cell mixture per well.
Incubate cells for 8 hours or up to 14 hours in a CO2 incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2, and 95% relative humidity.
Prepare MACS buffer by adding 10 mL of FBS to a 500 mL bottle of PBS. Keep on ice.
Harvest cells by pipetting each well up and down until mixed, then pool replicates in a 50 mL conical tube. Bring all tubes to equal volume with MACS buffer. Keep everything on ice.
Prepare staining solution by adding 2.5 μL of CD69 antibody to 250 μL of MACS Buffer per reaction. Centrifuge tubes at 800 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend with 250 μL staining solution per tube. Incubate at 4°C in the dark for 20 minutes.
Add 5 mL of MACS Buffer to each tube to wash the staining solution, briefly vortex.
Centrifuge tubes at 800 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C. Aspirate supernatant and resuspend with 1 mL MACS Buffer.
Filter cells by pipetting through a filter cap of a 5 mL tube. Keep tubes on ice until sort, no longer than two hours after staining.
Verify on FACS by transferring 5 μl of stained cells from each tube to a 96 well FACS plate.
Bring each well to 100 μl with MACS Buffer.
Select lasers and gates for lymphocytes, GFP, and antibody color.
Confirm the presence of a double-positive GFP+CD69+ population.
Sort cells at a sorting facility according to their protocols.
Sort GFP+CD69+ cells in MACS buffer.
Extract genomic DNA from sorted cells using the PureLink Genomic DNA kit.
Elute in 30 μl of elution buffer.
Store extracted genomic DNA at 4°C for up to a month or at -20°C indefinitely.
Prepare 200 μl Illumina amplification mix with appropriate index primer per sample.
Aliquot mix to 8 wells of a PCR plate or strips, 25 μl per well.
Amplify according to the program: Initial Denaturation at 95°C for 2 minutes.
Perform 35 cycles of 95°C for 20 seconds (denature), 66°C for 10 seconds (anneal), and 70°C for 15 seconds (extension).
Conduct a final extension at 70°C for 2 minutes.
Store PCR product at 4°C for up to a month or at -20°C indefinitely.
Pool all 8 reactions per index in a 1.5 mL eppendorf tube.
Purify reactions using NucleoSpin Gel and PCR purification kit, one column per index.
Elute purified samples in 15 μl Elution Buffer per column.

Pour a 2% agarose gel by mixing 2.4 g agarose with 120 mL TAE buffer, heat to above 95°C until fully dissolved, cool to 60°C, add 10 ul gel green, and cast in a gel tray with wide combs until solidified.
Combine 1 μl purified amplicon with 1 μl 6X loading dye.
Load mixture on the gel.
Run the gel at 120 V for 20 minutes or until the dye front has run 30% of the gel.
Image the gel in a gel imager at 302 nm UV wavelength.
Load 9 μl gel-dye onto the chip.
Add 5 μl Nano Marker to each sample well on the BioAnalyzer.
Load sample and ladder into appropriate wells on the chip.
Vortex the chip.
Place the chip in the BioAnalyzer.
Start analysis according to manufacturer's instructions.
Perform Illumina sequencing on HiSeq2500 at a sequencing facility as per their instructions.
Obtain final data as FASTQ files.
Convert basecalls with Illumina bcl2fastq2 software.
Create sample sheet with Illumina Experiment Manager.
Configure bclToFastq using configureBclToFastq.pl script.
Run bclToFastq using make command.
Download .fasta sequence for backbone plasmid from addgene.
Replace 2kb BsmBI stuffer sequence with a string of random nucleotides (36 bp).
Build the bwa index: bwa index -p ref backbone.fasta.
Align each sample to plasmid backbone with bwa: bwa mem -B 1 ref input.fastq > output.sam.
Trim alignment to only epitope region.
Translate read sequence to peptide sequence for each codon.
Count library peptide hits in the translated sequences.
Export read counts to .xls or .csv files.
Assign each epitope in a sorted sample a rank based on the number of reads corresponding to the epitope.
Average the ranks for replicates for a given sample to calculate ‘Average Rank’.
Plot Average Rank for the sort for a given TCR against the Mock-sort in scatter plots with each sort on either axis.
Validate the top hits using traditional in vitro assays.
